verdict.rationale: Sumsub's AML Screening is documented as an integrated part of the verification flow, screening against sanctions lists, PEP lists, watchlists, and adverse media, with configurable list/category targeting and fuzziness — all within the same API/dashboard used for identity verification, satisfying one-vendor/one-API/one-review-surface. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of screening accuracy or of the unified review surface in practice, and no detail on ongoing ongoing/ re-screening monitoring cadence.
